verdict.rationale: Custom agents are described as rules that enforce 'your organization's specific best practices across pull requests', and settings sit under a workspace with role-based access control. That suggests some org-wide rule application with centralized permissions. However, the documented config mechanism, cubic.yaml, is per-repository, living in each repo root as the source of truth. Nothing shows org-level defaults being inherited across many repos or exceptions being managed from one place. Missing for 10: documented org-level default configuration inherited by all repos, central exception/override management, evidence of bulk rollout across hundreds of repos, independent corroboration.
